title: Water at the door, ground floor, elderly

transcript_stream.speaker: operator
transcript_stream.text: Tell me about the water and who is there.

transcript_stream.speaker: caller
transcript_stream.text: It is at the door of our ground-floor flat. My father is elderly.

transcript_stream.speaker: operator
transcript_stream.text: Can he leave if the water comes in?

transcript_stream.speaker: caller
transcript_stream.text: Not quickly. I thought you only sent water, though.

transcript_stream.speaker: caller
transcript_stream.text: Long District, Phrae, near the invented blue temple.
